chapters: Jano' ba' jix duu maa'n oidha' tas gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia na ba' kuugalh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chin gu Jeremiiyas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tu' jix maa bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu Jerusalem gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' chɨkka cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jerusalem gu Judaa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' no'x bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx jix duu pai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ pai' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu vaakax; gio ba' bɨɨx juana' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Judaa gu Benjamiin jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' bɨx mi'p xikoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu noobh bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaakax bɨɨx tu'x a'bhar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ makgɨrxi guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro jix buusñi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Nabukodonosor ka't bhaan gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Mitriidates guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sesbassar gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix uam jodai mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix toja jodai guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix toja jodai mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' bɨx jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Sesbassar bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Babiloonia gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam oidha' gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhaan gu Babiloonia suulh gu Jerusalem gu Judaa maa'n kiicham.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx gu Sorobabeel gu Jesuaa gu Neemiias gu Seraiias gu Reelaiias gu Mardokêo gu Bilsaan gu Mispar gu Bigbai gu Reum gu Baana; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Paros gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' chamaam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sepatiias vaik guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ara guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Paat-moab gu ma'nkam gu Josuee gu Joab gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sattu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ oo'm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sakâi guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bani guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oo'm gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bebai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asgad mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Adonikam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bigbai gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Adin guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ater gu Esekîas guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Besai vaik guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jora chamaam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu asum guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gibbar guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bet-leem chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Netopa mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Anatot chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asmabet oo'm gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kîriat-jearim gu Kepira gu Beerot guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam oo'm vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rama gu Gabaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Mikmas chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Bet-el gu ai guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Nebo mambhɨɨx gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Magbis chamaam mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu arim vaik guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lod gu adid gu Ono guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jerikoo vaik oo'm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Senaa vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jedaiia gu vaak gu Jesuaa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Immer mambhɨɨx gɨ' mambhɨɨx gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Pasur mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oo'm kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu arim mambhɨɨx gɨ' mambhɨɨx kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jesuaa gu Kadmiel gu ma'nkam gu Odobiias guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maakobh.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asap chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam tu jiim; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sallum gu ma'nkam gu Ater gu ma'nkam gu Talmoon gu ma'nkam gu Akkub gu ma'nkam gu atita gu ma'nkam gu Sobai; mi' dhɨr bɨx chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' gu Netineos; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sia gu ma'nkam gu asupa gu ma'nkam gu Tabaot.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kêros gu ma'nkam gu Siaa gu ma'nkam gu Padoon.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebana gu ma'nkam gu agaba gu ma'nkam gu Akkub.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu agab gu ma'nkam gu Samlai gu ma'nkam gu anaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Giddel gu ma'nkam gu Gaer gu ma'nkam gu Reaiia.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Resin gu ma'nkam gu Nekoda gu ma'nkam gu Gasam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ussa gu ma'nkam gu Pasea gu ma'nkam gu Besai.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asena gu ma'nkam gu Meunim gu ma'nkam gu Nepusim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bakbuk gu ma'nkam gu akusa gu ma'nkam gu arur.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Baslut gu ma'nkam gu Meida gu ma'nkam gu arsa.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Barkos gu ma'nkam gu Sisera gu ma'nkam gu Tema.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Nesiia gu ma'nkam gu atipa.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam tu duukam gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sotai gu ma'nkam gu Soperet gu ma'nkam gu Peruda.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jaala gu ma'nkam gu Darkoon gu ma'nkam gu Giddel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sepatiias gu ma'nkam gu atil gu ma'nkam gu Pokêret-assebaim gu ma'nkam gu Ami.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Netineos tu' gu ma'nkam tu duukam gu Salomoon vaik guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gook.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Tel-mela gu Tel-arsa gu Kêrub gu Addan tu' gu Immer cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak tattat tu' gu ma'nkam tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Delaiia gu ma'nkam gu Tobiias gu ma'nkam gu Nekoda guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Abaiia gu ma'nkam gu Kos gu ma'nkam gu Barsillai jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Barsillai gu Galaadita ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham ka't gaagam; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Tirsata cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'x guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu Urim gu Tummim.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chio'ñ ka't oo'm gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' vaik guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' cham tu duukam ja'tkam na tu juan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' vaik guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv; gio ba' ko'kmarak guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oo'm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' jix ai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jixchamaam; gio ba' buur guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Na pai' dhuuk dhɨt ɨɨbhidham tattat na pai' dhuuk tɨɨtɨs gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix búup guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' bhaan tu' na jix kavɨk jix maa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix uam jodai jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix toja jodai guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kutun na jix toja guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu jiim gu Netineos jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu Llegado guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jɨ'dɨlh jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chio'ñ gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Jesuaa gu mar gu Josadek gu ja'tkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan na ja'p ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xoi'kam ko'kmarak ɨɨbhi'ñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh gu xumai.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ja'p ua'nak maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨɨx tas guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' dɨr maa'n gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv kua'da' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jix maa tuumiñ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jugi guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨ'ñdhatu' gu Sidonios gu Tirios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu Liibano gu gɨ' suudai' gu Joppe jurtu'nka' aagak gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi'.

Jano' ba' oidha' tas gook namkia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook kua'da' gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu Jesuaa gu mar gu Josadek gu ja'tkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨbiap guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Lebitas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' bia'ka' gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kuiñcha guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jano' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' gu ma'nkam tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' xoi'kam na ba' bɨɨx tas; na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa xoi'kam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Gu' gu' mi' dhɨr bɨx tu' daam kuiñcha guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam buimɨi kuiñcha chulhiiñdha' jix gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' dhi' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' na cham jir bhai' chɨɨdak dhi' tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx gu ja'tkam dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan no'ch bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' jix duu jir bhai'; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dhɨt guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kuiñcha dhi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Esdras tɨtdada' joi'ndam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jum daa'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sekâniias gu mar gu Jeiel gu ma'nkam gu Elam gu Esdras; gio ba' no'ch guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu u'vɨ jix duu gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; gu' cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn nɨɨra na ba' gu Israeel bhaan dhi'.

Jano' ba' jano' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Na gu' bamii' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn no'ch duduaka' bɨndak; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Esdras guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ chiñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx gu Israeel jix duu jurtu'nka' dhi'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Esdras vupui bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joanaan gu mar gu Eliasib; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham jix jugi gu takarui' tu' jix i'i gu suudai' na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem bɨx gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim vaik gu tanoolh jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chiñia' daraa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jum duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ chu'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa gu Benjamiin jum daa'ñ gu Jerusalem tu jiim vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' jix daa bɨx gu ja'tkam ɨrban gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kuiñcha guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu Esdras jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan uañi'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios tattat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn aagak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu u'vɨ jix duu.
Jano' ba' jix aa' bɨx mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gui'p guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam jix jai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu kavɨk na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' tu' tu duukam gu tanoolh tu' gook na gu' gu'ch mui'x guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ chiñia' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx daraa kiicham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ no'ch i'iich guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan dhi'.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jonataan gu mar gu Asael gu Jaasiias gu mar gu Tikba; gio ba' gu Mesullam gu Sabetai gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix bɨɨx duu gu Esdras jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu chio'ñ ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak tattat bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix dhadhaa maa'n gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ jix duu maa'n gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ jix duu jix bɨɨx duu bakia' dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jesuaa gu mar gu Josadek gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Elieser gu Jarib gu Gedaliias.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu novɨ daaxdhak guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
